name: memberships
description: A principal's membership in one company; access comes only from its unexpired grants.
lifecycle: Created ACTIVE; company administrators may suspend, reactivate or terminally remove membership with an observed version. Responsibility and the last active administrator are protected. Historical attribution is retained; no runtime deletion.

columns.Meaning: Company of the membership; immutable (tenant key).
Member principal; a principal may hold memberships in several companies that never see each other.
Optimistic concurrency token for membership changes.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A membership belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The member is an existing principal.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX memberships_company_id_id_key ON public.memberships USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key that tenant references target.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX memberships_company_principal_current_key ON public.memberships USING btree (company_id, principal_id) WHERE (status <> 'REMOVED'::"MembershipStatus")
constraints.Purpose: At most one current (not REMOVED) membership per principal and company; a removed membership stays as history and the person can return through a new membership.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX memberships_principal_status_idx ON public.memberships USING btree (principal_id, status)
